'''Mat Rags''' was a [[human]] who worked as a [[podracer]] [[Technician|mechanic]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="CVD" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> they were present<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena|Grand Arena]] of the [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]]<ref name="CVD" /> during the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|race]]. Prior to the race, Rags worked on the pod of a [[Vulptereen 327]] while its owner, [[Podracer (profession)|racer]] [[Dud Bolt]], sat in the [[cockpit]]. Rags and the other mechanics rushed off the grid once the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] signaled the start of the race, which was ultimately won by the [[Slavery|enslaved]] human [[Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TPM" />

During the race, Rags wore a [[Color|blue]] [[Clothing|worksuit]] with a black utility tool vest, black [[glove]]s, brown [[boot]]s, and pointed brown cowl with a pair of [[goggles]]. They had blue [[eye]]s and light skin.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mat Rags appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[Mat Rags/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the 1999 [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|video game]] adaptation of ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="TPM Game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref> There are multiple characters in the film wearing the same outfit as Rags who appear in a number of shots throughout the scenes in Mos Espa; however, it is only possible to distinguish Rags in one shot based on the colors visible on his utility tool vest.<ref name="TPM" />
